mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month growth in real personal consumption expenditures (PCE) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when RSAFS shows 3-month growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a contraction in supply, which leads to lower corporate output and earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and a decrease in unemployment rate signals a strengthening economy, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increase > 5% and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized signals inflationary pressure, which leads to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in a month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in GDP and an increase in the unemployment rate signals a weakening economy, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decline > 1% and UNRATE increase > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.
